apiKeyUsage.title: Using your keys
apiKeyUsage.subtitle: Call the API from a terminal, a script, or your own app
apiKeyUsage.intro: Send the key on the X-API-Key header, never on Authorization. Every admin endpoint accepts it, and the key's own permissions decide what it can reach.
apiKeyUsage.terminalHint: This endpoint answers with the key's own permissions whatever they are, so it is the fastest way to prove a key is live. Swap YOUR_KEY for the secret you copied.
apiKeyUsage.codeHint: Read the secret from an environment variable. A key pasted into source you commit is a key you will have to revoke.
apiKeyUsage.copyTerminalLabel: Copy the terminal example to clipboard
apiKeyUsage.copyCodeLabel: Copy the code example to clipboard
apiKeyUsage.copyFailed: Couldn't copy to the clipboard. Select the example above and copy it manually.

readiness.title: Store readiness
readiness.allPassing: Everything a submission needs is in place
readiness.noServerUrl: No public address is configured, so the checks that fetch from your domain cannot run. Set the website URL under Brand.

https.label: Public address uses HTTPS
https.fix: Serve this instance over https. Deep links and iOS transport security both refuse plain http.

brandIcon.label: Brand icon chosen
brandIcon.fix: Pick an icon under Settings → Brand; the generator downloads both app icons from it.

privacyPolicy.label: Privacy policy URL set
privacyPolicy.fix: Add one in the Contact & Website card under Settings → Brand. Both stores require it before a listing can be published.

appleAppSiteAssociation.label: Apple app site association file served
appleAppSiteAssociation.fix: Run native:init with --apple-team-id, then copy native/.well-known/ into the well-known folder beside your compose file.

androidAssetLinks.label: Android asset links file served
androidAssetLinks.fix: Run native:init with --android-fingerprint, then copy native/.well-known/ into the well-known folder beside your compose file.

appleWallet.label: Apple Wallet passes
appleWallet.fix: Optional. Set the Wallet__Apple__* variables (Pass Type ID, Team ID, .p12 certificate, WWDR certificate) to offer an Add to Apple Wallet pass on every booking.

googleWallet.label: Google Wallet passes
googleWallet.fix: Optional. Set Wallet__Google__IssuerId and Wallet__Google__ServiceAccountKeyPath to offer a Save to Google Wallet pass on every booking.

dateExceptions.title: Dates
dateExceptions.subtitleEmpty: Every date follows the weekly hours
dateExceptions.subtitle_one: {{count}} upcoming date differs from the weekly hours
dateExceptions.subtitle_other: {{count}} upcoming dates differ from the weekly hours
dateExceptions.hint: Plan around a specific date instead of the weekly hours: close for a bank holiday or a private event, run special hours, or take walk-ins only. Nothing here repeats, so add a date each year. Staff can still record bookings on any of them.
dateExceptions.closedDescription: No service that day. Existing bookings are flagged under schedule conflicts.
dateExceptions.specialHoursDescription: Replaces the weekly hours for that date, with its own last booking time. Bookings outside the new hours are flagged.
dateExceptions.walkInOnlyDescription: Open on the usual hours, but no online bookings. Existing bookings stand.
dateExceptions.replaceHint: That date is already listed; adding it again replaces the earlier entry.
